summary: Brian Fargo's post-apocalyptic RPG series, from the 1988 computer RPG through inXile's crowdfunded tactical sequels.

entries.title: Wasteland

emulation.notes: Use Wasteland Remastered natively; DOSBox/Apple II/C64 emulation is optional for historical comparison.

primary.why: Wasteland Remastered preserves the original game while adding overhauled graphics/sound, new portraits, voiced lines, and modern PC usability. Windows is the best archive/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Wasteland Remastered on Windows through Steam/GOG/Microsoft Store; use Apple II/C64/DOS only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Wasteland 2

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Director's Cut.

primary.why: Director's Cut upgrades the original with visual improvements, expanded voiceover, perks/quirks, Precision Strike, redesigned encounters, controller support, and UI changes. Windows is the highest-fidelity archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Wasteland 2: Director's Cut on Windows with current patches.
